before.description: Previous uncommitted Q4 invocation-reuse candidate, NOT unmodified main

selected_changes.shared_descriptor: FP32 and Q4 reuse the same existing fp32Kernel descriptor. Both use FP32 activations/output; descriptor has only x/y/w/n. Single-caller, non-recursive executor contract and joining all workers before clearing remain unchanged. Separate format-specific callbacks avoid a new per-job format branch.
selected_changes.lazy_initialization: FP32 callback is now initialized only on the first non-inline FP32 projection. Q4 callback remains lazy. Serial projections never initialize either callback.
selected_changes.safety_scan: Use abs Float32bits with an explicit upper bound at infinity for the existing magnitude threshold. NaNs still return false, +/-Inf true; equality at the limit remains false. Same threshold and wide-sum fallback, no admission or numerical tolerance changes.
selected_changes.structure: Production remains monolithic in cmd/monolith/monolith.go; arithmetic/reduction kernels, work threshold and worker partitioning unchanged. Q8 gets the common safety-scan change but NOT reusable invocation dispatch in this round.

footprint.descriptor_test: TestProjectionDescriptorFootprint failed before the change: actual184 versus compact120. It now passes at120 bytes on this Go/architecture.
footprint.scope: Struct bytes are not RSS or total executor allocation including channels/workers. The 184-byte baseline is the previous local Q4 candidate, not main. Relative to main, an extra Q4 callback slot remains; descriptor storage is shared. Warm ordinary Q4 and FP32 kernels remain allocation-free.

scan_probe.protocol: Three fresh processes, GOMAXPROCS=1, 32 rotating three-leg trials per length, same function-pointer layer and normal deterministic finite inputs, lengths64/256/704/1536/3584/16384. Roughly 2^20 scanned elements per timed leg. Full timing arrays retained.
scan_probe.unselected: Unsigned-subtraction range predicate also tested; similar results, but explicit upper/lower bounds selected for readability.
scan_probe.source_provenance: Probe was built before integration, against b544... runtime and test source5a3a46c915e2197775e18f69a9060eb23891a35b4a6b61d159e6950371ce2411. Retained test now includes additional mixed-format/lifetime assertions; predicate and timing bodies are unchanged.
scan_probe.limitations: Isolated full scans only, not a whole-Q4-kernel or generation speed ratio. Early-exit and exceptional-value timing not characterized; their Boolean decisions are tested.

correctness.guard: Compare frozen float predicate, production predicate and both bit predicates on signed limit-neighbor values, zeros/subnormals, infinities, multiple NaN encodings, short/long arrays and 65536 random17-lane bit-pattern vectors.
correctness.shared_state: TestSharedProjectionAlternatingFormats interleaves Q4/FP32/Q8 on the same executor with workers1/4 and rows1/3/4/5/17; outputs equal nil-executor reference and descriptor is clear after each call. Original Q4 bit/guard/worker-lifetime/independent-owner tests retained; no numerical assertions relaxed.
correctness.initialization: TestProjectionCallbacksStartLazy failed before integration due to eager callback; now passes for workers1/4.

generation.broad_protocol: Three before-after fresh-process blocks, alternating block order, 18 fixed format/worker/shape cases, 200ms benchmark leaves. Same synthetic model and benchmark harness as prior record. FP32 arithmetic unchanged but constructor/descriptor handling changed; Q8 also receives the scan change, so neither is a strictly unchanged-runtime control.
generation.broad_observations: Some Q4 workers4 medians near0.98, while FP32 workers1 had up to~1.015. Raw outliers retained. These short estimates are not sufficient to establish either speedup or regression.
generation.followup_reason: Investigate potential FP32 regression and favorable Q4 median rather than selecting one short-run result. Followup ran after other owned validation/model jobs completed; host background activity was not controlled.
generation.followup_protocol: 1s leaves, count1, five fresh before-after blocks alternating order; focus on prefix33/outputs128 with FP32 workers1 and Q4 workers4. Three additional same-binary baseline/baseline blocks for each condition. Ratios divide independently calibrated ns/op estimates, not per-request pairs.
generation.interpretation: Approximately neutral whole-generation timing. Initial2% Q4 improvement and~1.5% FP32 slowdown did not reproduce consistently. Longer FP32 samples still include ratios~0.948 and1.106; do not infer a universal no-regression guarantee or subtract control medians to manufacture a speedup.
generation.reproducer: scripts/summarize_q4_invocation.py accepts prefix, cases, runs, benchtime and before/after source and executable identities; summaries include raw-file and executable SHA-256. Recomputed broad summary compared byte-identical after parser updates.
generation.parser_verification: Unit tests enforce expected case counts, reject duplicate cases, preserve all samples and use declared historical source identities rather than hashing today's runtime as a historical build.

real_model_outputs.settings: generate -hf-model MODEL -weight-format FORMAT -weight-mib 14000 -prompt 'Write a detailed history of the city of Tokyo.' -max-tokens 128 -temperature 0 -threads 4; FORMAT=q4 or q8.
real_model_outputs.build: CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath ./cmd/monolith; before CLI is the preserved b544... candidate, after CLI sourceea77195...
real_model_outputs.comparison: cmp succeeded for complete stdout before/after within each format. No cross-format identity, independent token-ID validation or timing claim.
real_model_outputs.availability: Model, raw stdout and executables remain local ignored artifacts. Before source was an uncommitted candidate identified by its prior build record; no historical source snapshot is published by this receipt.

verification.go122_amd64: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.22.12 GOARCH=amd64 ./scripts/go.sh test ./cmd/monolith -run 'TestProjection|TestSharedProjection|TestWideSumScanPredicates|TestQ4|TestQ8|TestWorkerLinearSteadyAllocation' -count=1 passed under Rosetta; not native Linux testing
verification.python: python3 -m pytest scripts -q:52 passed,468 subtests passed
verification.scope: Tracked cmd/tools packages verified locally; full ./... remains affected by pre-existing ignored runs/dbg_special_test.go. No scratch data deleted and no remote CI or fork-review in this round.

decision: Keep the shared descriptor, lazy initialization and bounded bit scan as the current local candidate for lower invocation footprint and faster isolated ordinary scans. Do not claim whole-generation acceleration. Prior records and rejected experiments retained unchanged; no commit, push, PR or merge implied.
